framework_metadata.title: Continuous Mathematical Optimization on Multiscale Biological Systems
framework_metadata.system_description: Multiscale Cancer Pharmacokinetics, Intracellular Glycolytic Metabolism, and Cell Population Dynamics

complexity_bounds.discrete_search: O(K^M) exponential complexity (for K choices and M dimensions)
complexity_bounds.riemannian_gradient_flow: O(1/epsilon) polynomial or linear complexity bounds on continuous sphere manifolds
complexity_bounds.approximation_ratio: 0.878 or higher, significantly tightening the discrete gap compared to standard SDP or convex simplex relaxations.

theoretical_insights.manifold_topology: By mapping discrete points to vertices of the sphere manifold S^(K-1), the landscape is smoothed into a continuous differentiable surface, eliminating combinatorial discontinuities and allowing gradient flows to guide global trajectory search.
